title: Hyper3-CLIP: Hierarchy-Conditioned Hyperbolic Vision-Language Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.29313v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: CLIP-like vision-language models (VLMs) trained with contrastive objectives learn strong global image-text representations, but their Euclidean embeddings and global pooling fail to encode relational structure such as part-whole and parent-child relations. Hyperbolic VLMs address this gap with entailment-based objectives, and text-conditioned variants improve fine-grained alignment through sentence- and phrase-level queries. However, these two lines of work remain separate: hyperbolic VLMs use static image and region features, while query-conditioned methods lack hierarchical geometric structure. We present Hyper3-CLIP, a hierarchy-conditioned hyperbolic VLM that combines global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling. To train the model, we construct lightweight query hierarchies from text, comprising full captions, sentence fragments, localized part descriptions, and extracted phrases. Each

translated_title: Hyper3-CLIP：层次条件化的双曲视觉-语言训练
translated_abstract: 采用对比目标训练的类CLIP视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够学习到强大的全局图像-文本表示，但其欧几里得嵌入和全局池化无法编码部分-整体和父子关系等关系结构。双曲VLM通过基于蕴含的目标弥补了这一缺陷，而文本条件化的变体则通过句子级和短语级查询改进细粒度对齐。然而，这两条研究路线仍然相互独立：双曲VLM使用静态的图像和区域特征，而查询条件化方法缺乏层次化几何结构。我们提出了Hyper3-CLIP，这是一个层次条件化的双曲VLM，它将全局、局部和全局-局部对比学习与查询条件化视觉池化相结合。为了训练该模型，我们从文本构建轻量级的查询层次结构，包括完整描述、句子片段、局部部件描述和提取的短语。
tldr: 提出了Hyper3-CLIP，通过将全局、局部和全局-局部对比学习与基于文本查询层次结构的查询条件化视觉池化相结合，首次在双曲几何框架下统一了层次化关系结构与细粒度文本条件化对齐。
en_tdlr: Hyper3-CLIP unifies hierarchical relational structure and fine-grained text-conditioned alignment in hyperbolic geometry by combining global, local, and global-local contrastive learning with query-conditioned visual pooling built from lightweight text query hierarchies.
